verdict.rationale: Fern ships an official, documented CLI that initializes projects, validates API definitions, previews changes locally and publishes docs and SDKs. A probe confirms the CLI reference exists, and Fern's MCP server lets coding agents look up its CLI commands. The JSON-speaking, agent-pipeable CLI claims describe CLIs Fern generates for customers' APIs, not Fern's own CLI, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: documented agent-oriented features of Fern's own CLI (e.g., machine-readable/JSON output, non-interactive modes), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Fern CLI lets you initialize projects, validate API definitions, preview changes locally, and publish documentation and SDKs.
Run a local preview server to view documentation changes instantly with hot reload.
Register it with your coding agent to look up `docs.yml` syntax, components, and CLI commands while you build
